reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, the previous rejected raw-HD output, the complete unchanged repaired raw RGB output, the complete white/cyan/alpha sheet and the unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The invented brown moustache is completely removed; the upper lip and chin are smooth yellow with exactly one small serious mouth. The rightward head direction, short temple hair, separate brows, olive cap and uniform with red-gold details remain. No large hanging cross has been copied from another source. The closed collar fits a compact round head with no long yellow neck, pinched ring, floating cloth or cream bib.
entries.alpha_decision: The returned RGB preserves the entire pale painted backing and opaque clothing. Full white/cyan inspection shows no transparency, visible holes or missing backing. No alpha derivation was needed or performed.
entries.visible_limitations: Tiny source upper-lip shading is not treated as evidence for a moustache. Fine cap/tab engraving remains pixel-limited, while the corrected smooth upper lip is clearly visible and was inspected directly.
